headline.purpose: names in lists, card titles, setting names

body.purpose: anything you read or press on a phone

footnote.purpose: help under a field or a title

group.purpose: the small heading over a group of rows; never uppercase

figures.purpose: Numbers that identify something (room numbers, dates in the grid, times, counts, the clock) are set tabular so columns line up.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: The chosen segment and a switch handle, lifted off its track.

shadows.name: shadow
shadows.value: 0 1px 3px rgb(var(--shadow-rgb) / calc(0.1 * var(--shadow-k))), 0 1px 2px rgb(var(--shadow-rgb) / calc(0.06 * var(--shadow-k)))

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.value: 0 0 0 1px rgb(var(--edge-rgb) / var(--ring-a)), 0 4px 12px rgb(var(--shadow-rgb) / calc(0.08 * var(--shadow-k))), 0 1px 3px rgb(var(--shadow-rgb) / calc(0.06 * var(--shadow-k)))
shadows.purpose: Popovers and menus that drop from a button.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.value: 0 0 0 1px rgb(var(--edge-rgb) / var(--ring-a)), 0 12px 32px rgb(var(--shadow-rgb) / calc(0.14 * var(--shadow-k))), 0 2px 6px rgb(var(--shadow-rgb) / calc(0.08 * var(--shadow-k)))
shadows.purpose: Sheets, toasts and the unsaved change card. Dark raises --shadow-k to 3 and draws a hairline ring.

motion.name: dur-quick
motion.purpose: Colour changes on buttons, fields and segments.

motion.name: dur-base
motion.purpose: Fades, the page fade-in, sheets leaving.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Everything that arrives or changes state.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Tablet layout; the phone tab bar gives way to the header navigation.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Pointer sizes: controls drop from 44px to 40px.

breakpoints.name: short
breakpoints.purpose: A phone held sideways: one line of controls, bottom sheets, no tab bar, side gutters clear the notch (px-safe).

components.name: Button
components.description: The default: a firm ink tint that deepens on hover and press. Filled, never outlined.
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;font-family:var(--font-sans, 'Outfit'), system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);background:var(--btn, rgb(38 31 28 / 0.13));color:var(--ink, #261f1c);}.ds-btn:hover{background:var(--btn-hover, rgb(38 31 28 / 0.19));}.ds-btn:active{background:var(--btn-press, rgb(38 31 28 / 0.26));}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent, #1d6b50);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ledger green, at most one per view, never destructive.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 256 256" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M228 128a12 12 0 0 1-12 12h-76v76a12 12 0 0 1-24 0v-76H40a12 12 0 0 1 0-24h76V40a12 12 0 0 1 24 0v76h76a12 12 0 0 1 12 12Z"/></svg>New Booking</button>

components.name: Hold Button
components.description: Straw with a dashed edge: put on hold, keep on hold. Straw means on hold and nothing else.

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Brick words on a brick tint: delete, cancel a stay.

components.name: On Button
components.description: Solid ink with white words: a chosen filter, tab or tool. Ink means this one is on.

components.name: Field
components.description: White, a visible 1px edge (3.35:1), 44px on touch, 16px type so phones never zoom.
components.css: .ds-field{display:block;width:100%;min-height:44px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--field-line, #948b80);border-radius:6px;background:var(--surface, #ffffff);color:var(--ink, #261f1c);font-family:var(--font-sans, 'Outfit'), system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:16px;transition:border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);}.ds-field::placeholder{color:var(--muted, #6f655c);}.ds-field:hover{border-color:var(--ink, #261f1c);}.ds-field:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:var(--accent, #1d6b50);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--accent, #1d6b50),0 0 0 4px var(--accent-soft, #e6f0ea);}

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: A tinted track with the chosen segment raised in white: calendar views, floors, booking steps, sort direction.

components.name: Phone Tab Bar
components.description: Five tabs on an upright phone; filled symbol and a green label for the current one. White at 95% with a light blur, clear of the home indicator.

components.name: Booking Bar
components.description: A stay on the calendar: a muted index-card tint with a firmer edge. On hold is straw, dashed and hatched so it reads without colour.

Dr PK Banerjee
MMT Rathinam

narrative.overview: A front desk tool, not a showcase. One person, often older, often on a phone, often mid-conversation with a guest. The thesis is **the register**: ink on paper, every room number, date and count set in hyperlegible figures, one green action per screen, and every state told in words and shape as well as colour. The thing it is remembered by is its type: one round, open typeface (Outfit) for every word and every number.
keyCharacteristics: Ink on paper: warm neutrals on a paper canvas, white cards with hairline edges.
One accent, ledger green, for the one action per screen.
Every state told in words and shape as well as colour.
One typeface, Outfit, for every word and every number.
Flat; only things that float over the page get a shadow.

rules.name: Ink means "this one is on."
rules.body: A tool that is on, the chosen filter, the chosen settings tab, the selection bar under the calendar and the mode banner are solid ink with white words. Selection inside a picker (a colour, a status, a room) is a 2px ink ring with a gap.

rules.name: Straw yellow means on hold, and nothing else
rules.body: the hold status, the On Hold tool and its banner, Keep On Hold. Always with a dashed edge, so it reads without colour.

rules.name: Brick red means leaving, delete or cancel
rules.body: errors sit on `danger-soft` with brick words, no thick border.

rules.name: A phone is for looking at the calendar
rules.body: upright or sideways (the `short:` variant, used more): no tools, no Today card, no zoom buttons (pinch instead), the days shown inside the View menu, and the page itself never scrolls (it is locked; only the calendar scrolls inside).

rules.name: Flat
rules.body: Cards are white with a hairline and no shadow. Only things that float over the page get a shadow (sheets, popovers, toasts, the unsaved change card). The header and the phone tab bar are white at 95% with a light blur.

dos: Do show one clear next step, with a number, when a task has steps.
Do keep text short: a label, then at most one line of help.
donts: Don't add a second accent colour, a second radius, a colour per tool, or Lucide icons (Phosphor only).
Don't put an icon in front of a label that already says what it is.
Don't animate cancel or close icons, and don't tilt icons; keep icon motion to a lift, a turn or a nudge the way the icon points.
Don't use dashes in UI text.

Don't put controls on top of the calendar. Zoom, tools and Undo live outside it. The only things drawn over it are the confirm bar after a first tap, the booking bars' own handles, and the booking panel on wide screens (which never resizes the calendar).
Don't add a colour for decoration. Colour means status, floor, or the one green accent. Booking and guest colours are optional and limited to four swatches plus Custom.
